verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a dedicated Batch API for processing groups of requests asynchronously, explicitly designed for bulk workloads, plus rate-limit and caching mechanics that support high-volume processing (docs-8, docs-12/19/22). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the Batch API itself (community evidence only discusses rate-limit friction on standard chat endpoints, not batch usage), and no benchmarks quantifying throughput for large-scale bulk jobs.
